snippet.title: "KOWLOON'S GATE Suzaku" for Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
The legendary cult classic from the original PlayStation era is coming to Nintendo Switch™ on Thursday, October 29, 2026!

▽ What is "KOWLOON'S GATE Suzaku"?
It is the ultimate "strolling game," reimagining the worldview of the 1997 classic Kowloon's Gate.

Set as a prequel to Kowloon's Gate, you can wander through the maze-like alleys of Kowloon Walled City and take in the atmosphere of a city submerged in memory—from angles and locations never before seen in the original game.

Your objective is to use photos from an album you've found as clues to track down those exact locations and bring back memories through "psychography" (thoughtography).

Familiar faces await you in these iconic places, now rendered in even higher definition.

We invite you to step into this world and discover for yourself what kind of memories will be brought back to life.

◆Nintendo Store : https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/kowloons-gate-suzaku-switch/
◆Official Website: https://kowloonsgate-suzaku.net/
◆Official Social Media: https://x.com/kowloonsgate_vr
